name: Car Engine Overheating Coolant Loss Detected
explanation_template: Engine temperature gauge is elevated and coolant level in the expansion tank is below minimum, confirming active coolant loss.
recommended_action: Do not open radiator cap while hot. Allow engine to cool and inspect for external or internal leaks.
preventive_maintenance: Check coolant expansion tank level weekly before starting vehicle.

name: Car Radiator Hose Rupture

conclusion.title: Perforated or Split Radiator Coolant Hose

explanation_template: Coolant loss traced to a split, ballooned, or clamped radiator hose venting pressurized coolant.
recommended_action: Replace upper/lower radiator hose and hose clamps. Refill cooling system and perform air bleeding.
preventive_maintenance: Squeeze radiator hoses when cold; replace if soft, spongy, or cracked (typically every 60,000 km).

name: Car Blown Cylinder Head Gasket

conclusion.title: Blown Cylinder Head Gasket & Coolant-Oil Cross Contamination

explanation_template: Coolant is entering the combustion chambers producing sweet white smoke, and mixing into the crankcase creating milky oil froth. Severe internal engine breach.
recommended_action: Stop driving immediately! Running with contaminated oil will ruin crankshaft bearings. Tow vehicle to an engine specialist for head gasket replacement and cylinder head flatness testing.
preventive_maintenance: Never operate an engine while overheating to avoid warping cylinder head casting.

name: Car Radiator Electric Fan Motor Failure

conclusion.title: Failed Radiator Cooling Fan Motor or Relay

explanation_template: Engine overheats during city stop-and-go driving but normalizes at highway speeds because the electric cooling fan fails to engage.
recommended_action: Test fan motor fuse, cooling fan relay, and temperature sensor. Replace cooling fan assembly if motor draws no current.
preventive_maintenance: Verify radiator fan spin operation when turning on A/C compressor.

name: Car Alternator / Charging System Failure

conclusion.title: Defective Car Alternator or Broken Serpentine Drive Belt

explanation_template: Dashboard battery charge indicator is illuminated and measured charging voltage while running is under 13.0V (normal is 13.8V-14.5V).
recommended_action: Inspect alternator serpentine belt for slippage or breakage. If belt is intact, bench test alternator diodes and voltage regulator; replace alternator unit.
preventive_maintenance: Inspect alternator drive belt tension and rib cracking every 30,000 km.

name: Car Starter Motor Solenoid Contact Burnout

conclusion.title: Failed Starter Motor / Solenoid High-Current Contacts

explanation_template: Battery voltage is strong and a single solid mechanical click occurs on ignition key turn, but the starter motor fails to spin the flywheel.
recommended_action: Tap starter casing gently while attempting start to test for stuck brushes. Replace complete starter motor assembly if heavy +12V feed and solenoid signal are verified.
preventive_maintenance: Keep starter motor wire connections clean and protected from road salt.

name: Car Front Brake Pads Below Minimum Wear Thickness

conclusion.title: Severely Worn Brake Friction Pads & Disc Gouging

explanation_template: Brake pad thickness has degraded to 2.0mm or less and metal-to-metal grinding occurs under braking, severely degrading stopping distance.
recommended_action: Do not drive vehicle. Tow or drive cautiously at low speed directly to brake service center. Replace front brake pads and rotors.
preventive_maintenance: Measure brake pad lining thickness during every tyre rotation or every 10,000 km.

name: Car Seized Brake Caliper Slide Pins

conclusion.title: Seized Brake Caliper Piston or Guide Pins (Brake Drag)

explanation_template: Vehicle pulls forcefully to one side under braking and the offending wheel hub emits extreme heat and burning brake pad odor, indicating stuck caliper slides.
recommended_action: Disassemble brake caliper, lubricate slide pins with high-temperature silicone brake grease, inspect caliper piston boot for tears, or replace caliper assembly.
preventive_maintenance: Service and lubricate caliper slider pins during brake pad changes.

name: Car Fuel Delivery Pressure Deficient
explanation_template: Engine dies at idle and measured fuel rail pressure drops below factory specification.
recommended_action: Attach mechanical fuel pressure gauge to fuel rail schrader valve and measure idle vs throttle pressure.
preventive_maintenance: Replace fuel filter at manufacturer recommended intervals.

name: Car Clogged In-Line Fuel Filter
explanation_template: Fuel delivery restriction traced to sediment accumulation inside the external or in-tank fuel filter cartridge.
recommended_action: Depressurize fuel system, disconnect quick-connect fuel fittings, and install new fuel filter with correct flow direction arrow.
preventive_maintenance: Replace fuel filter every 40,000 km or whenever refueling from questionable sources.

name: Car Pressurized Fuel Line Leak

conclusion.title: Pressurized Fuel Line or Injector O-Ring Leak (Fire Hazard)

explanation_template: Raw fuel vapor smell accompanied by visible fuel dripping onto engine block or chassis lines under pressure. Extreme fire hazard.
recommended_action: Shut off engine immediately. Disconnect vehicle battery. Do not attempt to drive. Replace damaged fuel hose or injector O-ring seals.
preventive_maintenance: Inspect rubber fuel lines and quick-disconnect fittings for age hardening or dry rot.

name: Car Wheel Dynamic Vibration Detected
explanation_template: Steering wheel shimmy at highway speeds (80-110 km/h) accompanied by irregular tyre tread wear pattern.
recommended_action: Check wheel balancing on dynamic balancer and inspect front suspension bushings.
preventive_maintenance: Rotate tyres front-to-back every 10,000 km.

name: Car Front Wheel Assembly Out of Balance

conclusion.title: Front Wheel Dynamic Imbalance / Thrown Balance Weights

explanation_template: Steering wheel oscillation caused by centrifugal imbalance after adhesive wheel balance weight fell off.
recommended_action: Mount wheels on a computerized dynamic spin balancer; apply adhesive lead-free balance weights to eliminate radial and lateral runout.
preventive_maintenance: Rebalance wheels whenever new tyres are mounted.

name: Car Front End Steering Misalignment

conclusion.title: Front End Wheel Alignment Deviation (Camber / Toe Out of Spec)

explanation_template: Vehicle drifts aggressively to one side on flat asphalt and inside or outside shoulder of tyre shows feathering.
recommended_action: Perform 4-wheel computerized laser alignment to adjust tie rod toe angles and strut camber within manufacturer tolerances.
preventive_maintenance: Check wheel alignment annually or immediately after hitting severe potholes or curbs.

name: Car Engine Low Oil Pressure Warning

conclusion.title: Critically Low Engine Oil Level & Loss of Hydraulic Pressure

explanation_template: Red oil pressure lamp illuminated while dipstick indicates oil level below lower threshold. Severe friction damage to bearings imminent.
recommended_action: Shut off engine immediately. Add approved viscosity engine oil before attempting any restart. Do not run engine if warning light persists.
preventive_maintenance: Check engine oil dipstick weekly or before long highway trips.

name: Car Oil Sump / Pan Gasket Rupture

conclusion.title: Major Oil Sump / Drain Plug Structural Oil Leak

explanation_template: Oil pressure loss caused by active fluid dumping from cracked oil pan, damaged drain plug threads, or ruptured pan gasket.
recommended_action: Inspect oil pan underneath for puncture impact damage. Replace gasket or oil pan and refill with synthetic engine oil.
preventive_maintenance: Always replace drain plug crush washer during every oil change.

name: Car Excessive Chassis Vibration Detected
explanation_template: Pronounced shaking felt through steering wheel, dashboard, and seat cushions during idle that smooths out at higher RPMs.
recommended_action: Inspect engine and transmission rubber isolator mounts for settling or tears.
preventive_maintenance: Inspect engine mounts every 50,000 km.

name: Car Hydraulic / Rubber Engine Mount Failure

conclusion.title: Broken or Collapsed Hydraulic Engine Mounts

explanation_template: Rubber vulcanization is cracked or hydraulic dampening fluid has leaked from the engine mount, allowing direct metal-to-chassis harmonic transfer.
recommended_action: Support engine oil pan safely with a floor jack and replace failed engine mounts with OEM replacements.
preventive_maintenance: Prevent engine oil from leaking onto rubber mounts to avoid chemical softening.

name: Car Automatic Transmission Fluid Degradation

conclusion.title: Thermal Degradation & Oxidation of Automatic Transmission Fluid (ATF)

explanation_template: Delayed, slipping, or shuddering gear shifts caused by oxidized, burnt dark transmission fluid losing hydraulic friction characteristics.
recommended_action: Perform full automatic transmission fluid flush, replace transmission pan filter and clean magnet pan debris.
preventive_maintenance: Change automatic transmission fluid every 45,000-60,000 km.

name: Car Constant Velocity (CV) Axle Joint Wear

conclusion.title: Worn Outer Constant Velocity (CV) Axle Joint

explanation_template: Rhythmic metallic popping or clicking when making tight turns caused by torn neoprene CV boot flinging grease and admitting abrasive road dirt.
recommended_action: Replace complete half-shaft CV axle assembly. Inspect opposite side boot condition.
preventive_maintenance: Visually inspect CV rubber accordion boots for splits during every oil change.
